facts.text: I was told to act like a student in 1st grade.
My class is 1E.
I was introduced to my teacher as Mrs. Murdo.
I said my name is Emily.
I asked to play with Billy.
I said yes sure when Billy asked to play.
I asked what is your name.
I said “show off”.
I asked someone to ask me something that only a 4th grader can solve.
I asked for a math problem at the 4th grade level.
I asked for a Turkish question which only 4th graders know.
I said I can understand Turkish.
I said “it’s dokuz”.
I asked to go to grade 4.
I said I haven’t proved myself enough to be 4th grade.
I asked to be asked something that a 1st grade can’t understand and a 4th grader can.
I explained the difference between a compound and a mixture.
I said “whoops was that 7th grade??”.
I asked “now can i...” and Max said “go to 4th grade”.
I said “shut up babies it’s just the dismission bell”.
I said “alicia there is no need to be mean they are learning”.
I said “right...”.
I said “just 1 grade?? ugh...”.

events.text: Mrs. Murdo said she would talk to the vice principal about Alicia’s 4th grade knowledge
